referents.why: The third person masculine singular 'he' agrees with w2, the LORD, the subject of the first line; the second line keeps the same subject by parallelism. The feminine craving cannot be the subject of a masculine verb.

links.why: Waw opening the second line sets the contrast 'but He denies'. Contrast by sense, not cause, result or purpose; the 'and' link stands.

groups.why: Two lines with the same subject, the LORD, the second restating the roles of the first: the righteous are not left hungry; the craving of the wicked is refused. The group subject is the LORD, so it is flagged divine.
groups.category: same subject restated across two lines

none_fit.what: antithetic pair joined by a plain waw; the contrast link needs an explicit but-word
